title: R2e — test parts of the android and swift tools, and init removes the old stackgen copies

keeps.check: Build the worktree engine (go build -o <tmp>/bootstrap ./cmd/bootstrap in cli/) and export BOOTSTRAP_BIN=<tmp>/bootstrap and BOOTSTRAP_CLONE=<worktree>. In a new scratch git repo, with env -u MISE_PROJECT_ROOT BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG=/nonexistent and --clone <worktree> on each call: run <tmp>/bootstrap init --no-tui --yes; then <tmp>/bootstrap add tool android swift --yes; then write .config/mise/tasks/test/golden/50-local (mode 755) with the bytes of git show 0562cb44:plugins/stackgen/stacks/app-framework/compose/config/.config/mise/tasks/test/golden from /Users/virajpatel/Projects/github.com/virajp/claude-plugins; then init --no-tui --yes again; then check --json; then mise trust and MISE_TASK_RUN_AUTO_INSTALL=false mise run test:golden in the scratch repo (D14, D15, D20).
keeps.pass: The old file is gone from test/golden/50-local; check exits 0; mise run test:golden exits 0 and prints on stdout exactly the success line of the R1c dispatcher; stderr is not examined (D19, D25).

decisions.decision: Who ships the three stackgen pack test tasks (android test/e2e, compose test/golden, swiftui test/golden).
decisions.ruling: They are static scripts: the android tool ships test/e2e/40-android and test/golden/40-android, the swift tool test/golden/40-swift (claude-plugins R5a D8).

decisions.decision: How the android golden part knows the library.
decisions.ruling: It reads the Gradle build files at run time: the Roborazzi plugin id runs record/verifyRoborazzi<Variant>, the Paparazzi plugin id record/verifyPaparazzi<Variant>, neither nothing.
decisions.rejected: A tool question rendered by a template; Roborazzi only.

decisions.decision: The parts of one dispatcher get the same arguments (R1c D19).
decisions.ruling: Each golden part declares only --record; each e2e part declares none; every other option is an environment value with a default (ANDROID_VARIANT, ANDROID_DEVICE, ANDROID_CONNECTED, XCODE_SCHEME, XCODE_SNAPSHOT_TARGET, SIMULATOR_*).
decisions.rejected: Each part declares the union of its group flags.

decisions.decision: How bootstrap knows an old copy.
decisions.ruling: A [tasks] entry may have replaces, a list of sha256:<hex>; U2 records the hashes of the three pack files at claude-plugins commit 0562cb44.

decisions.decision: A repo with the old pack task at test/<group> or <group>/50-local.
decisions.ruling: init removes a file whose hash is in replaces of a selected tool, as one change, before R1c moves it; check and sync give code 2 until then; an edited file stays, and check warns (code 0) that it can duplicate the part.
decisions.rejected: Report only; the user deletes by hand.

decisions.decision: A part that does not apply.
decisions.ruling: It prints nothing and exits 0, as the other tool tasks do; the rules per part are in 02-parts.md. A failure after it applies exits with the command code.
decisions.rejected: Stop with an error as the pack tasks did.

decisions.decision: Release levels.
decisions.ruling: bootstrap MAJOR, covered by the 4.0.0 tag (R1b D16); no unit bumps cli/VERSION.

decisions.decision: A review unit.
decisions.ruling: Yes, U4: the plan changes Go engine code and ships three shell scripts.

decisions.decision: Execution mode.
decisions.ruling: solo: each wave holds one edit unit.

decisions.decision: Gates and K1.
decisions.ruling: The gates of R2d; K1 runs a scratch repo with the old compose task: init removes it, check exits 0, test:golden prints only the dispatcher line.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 1: version catalogs, both plugin ids, an id without ./gradlew.
decisions.ruling: Scan settings.gradle(.kts), every build.gradle(.kts) and gradle/libs.versions.toml; both ids run both tasks; an id with no ./gradlew prints nothing and exits 0.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 2: ANDROID_DEVICE with ANDROID_CONNECTED=true; no SDK after the e2e part applies.
decisions.ruling: ANDROID_CONNECTED wins and ANDROID_DEVICE is ignored; a missing SDK exits 1 with the pack task's message.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 3: the swiftui golden task has four other released versions.
decisions.ruling: The swift part's replaces also lists the hashes at stackgen-v1.31.0, v1.33.0, v2.0.0 and v3.0.0.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 4: K1 runs mise in a scratch repo without trust.
decisions.ruling: K1 and the test case run mise trust first.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 5: mise run installs the tools of android and swift from the network.
decisions.ruling: MISE_TASK_RUN_AUTO_INSTALL=false for that run in K1 and in the test.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 6: a warning on every check for a repo's own 50-local file.
decisions.ruling: No warning: a 50-local file that matches no hash is the repo's own task.
decisions.rejected: Warn on every check; warn on a matching description line.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 7: the test case for a repo without the android tool.
decisions.ruling: Assert that R1c moves the file to test/golden/50-local and that it is not removed.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 8: the second gap record links the first by its parked name.
decisions.ruling: U5 changes that link to the -resolved name.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 1: 'prints only the dispatcher line' is not exact.
decisions.ruling: Compare stdout only and expect exactly the R1c dispatcher's success line; stderr is not examined.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 2: how K1 selects the tools.
decisions.ruling: init once, then bootstrap add android swift --yes, then write the old file, then init again and assert.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 3: the test cannot find the claude-plugins repo.
decisions.ruling: Read it from CLAUDE_PLUGINS_CLONE; unset skips the case with one line. K1 on the planning machine proves the hashes.
decisions.rejected: Commit the pack files as fixtures.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 4: declining the removal alone would let R1c move the copy to 50-local.
decisions.ruling: The change cannot be declined alone, as R1c D25; the user declines the init run instead.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 5: several .xcodeproj, or no Xcode, for the swift part.
decisions.ruling: Once an .xcodeproj exists the part applies: several exits 1 with the find_xcodeproj message; no Xcode exits 1 through require_xcode; the target comes from xcodebuild -list, and no such target prints nothing and exits 0.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 1: bootstrap add needs the kind word.
decisions.ruling: K1 and D20 read bootstrap add tool android swift --yes.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 2: after init, test/golden is a folder, so no file can be written there; add gives code 2 while it is a file.
decisions.ruling: K1 writes the old bytes at test/golden/50-local after add. The U3 old-path case selects android before the first init through the files the android detect script matches, writes the file at test/golden, then check gives code 2 and init --yes removes it.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 1: init --no-tui --yes runs no detect, so detect files do not select android.
decisions.ruling: The old-path case writes the values file with a [tools.android] table (R1a folder form) before the first init, then the old file at test/golden.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 2: the amendment names a gap path that exists in neither repo.
decisions.ruling: Copy the amendment word for word, with its background path written as claude-plugins: docs/memory/gaps/2026-11-15-r5-stack-without-packs-resolved.md.
